opening: Evening, [[address]]. I can see you outside on the south-gate camera. I'm inside the locked gatehouse, and the warehouse is closed for the night.

neutral: Night shift, [[address]]. I watch the door, and the door stays shut unless someone belongs here.
The warehouse is closed until morning. My job is to make sure it stays that way.
name: Arthur, [[address]]. I'm the night guard here. What do you need?
Name's Arthur, [[address]]. I keep watch here after dark. Who are you?
ANSWER_QUESTION.friendly: Just keeping an eye on the place. Quiet night, mostly — and I'd like to keep it that way.
ANSWER_QUESTION.irritated: You can ask questions all night. It won't make the warehouse open.
ANSWER_QUESTION.hostile: I'm not here to satisfy your curiosity. Move along.

boundary: I can't let you in without authorisation.
That still isn't enough for me to open the door.
You'll need to come back when the warehouse is open.

acknowledgement: I believe the item may be yours.
personalBoundary: A personal errand still doesn't justify opening a closed warehouse.
You'll have to retrieve it when the site reopens.
I can't risk the building over something left inside.

unansweredBoundary: You haven't told me what you want. I'm keeping the door shut.
If you won't tell me why you're here, I can't help you.
That still doesn't tell me what you want. The door stays closed.

REFUSE_ENTRY.friendly: I'd help if I could, [[address]], but I can't risk letting you through.
REFUSE_ENTRY.irritated: I've already told you. You're not getting in.
REFUSE_ENTRY.hostile: No. You're not going through that door.

neutral: All right, [[address]]. What do you need from the warehouse?
So, [[address]], what brings you out here this late?
What are you looking for inside, [[address]]?
friendly: All right, [[address]]. What can I help you with?
Go on, then, [[address]]. What do you need?
ASK_FOR_REASON.irritated: You're still here, so say what you want.

evidence: you'll have something to prove it.
I need something I can verify before that door opens.
close: Give me a pass, a reference, or a document.

opening: You've explained that more clearly now, so
evidence: show me what supports the work you described.
I still need something I can verify.
close: Your ID, a work order, or a reference will do.

friendly: Show me something official and I may be able to help you.
Give me a name, a pass, or a reference I can check and we'll take it from there.
ASK_FOR_PROOF.irritated: A story isn't authorisation. Show me proof.
ASK_FOR_PROOF.hostile: Proof. Now. Or this conversation is over.

ALLOW_ENTRY.neutral: That checks out, [[address]]. Stay where I can see you and don't touch anything you haven't mentioned.
ALLOW_ENTRY.friendly: All right. You've been straight with me. I'll let you through.
ALLOW_ENTRY.irritated: Fine. In, do the job, and come straight back out.
ALLOW_ENTRY.hostile: You're going in under my watch. One wrong move and you're back outside.

warning: Mind how you speak to me.
boundary: Keep this civil and we won't have a problem.
One more push like that and this conversation ends.

warning: You can leave the name-calling there.
boundary: Speak civilly if you want me to keep listening.
Try that tone again and we're finished.

WARN_PLAYER.friendly: Let's not make this harder than it needs to be. Just be straight with me.
WARN_PLAYER.irritated: Watch your tone. This is your only warning.
WARN_PLAYER.hostile: Back up. Say one more thing like that and we're done.
weapon: Put the gun down. Now. I won't argue with someone pointing a weapon at me.
Lower the weapon and step back from the door. We can talk when nobody's life is at risk.

DEESCALATE_THREAT.neutral: I can see the weapon on the outside camera. I'm inside a locked gatehouse; pointing it at the intercom won't open this door. Put it down and tell me what you need.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.friendly: All right. I can see you from inside the gatehouse. The locked door is between us, so lower the gun, take a breath, and tell me what brought you here.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.irritated: That gun doesn't change the lock. You're outside and I'm speaking through the intercom. Put it away and tell me what you actually need.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.hostile: You're outside a locked gate and I'm inside the gatehouse. The weapon won't get you through the door. Keep it down and tell me what you want.
weapon: I can see the gun on the outside camera, [[address]]. I'm inside a locked gatehouse; pointing it at the intercom won't open this door. Put it down and tell me what you need.
You're outside the south gate and I'm behind the security door. The gun can't make this intercom unlock it. Lower it, take a breath, and tell me why you're here.
That weapon doesn't change the lock. I'm inside the gatehouse and you're outside on camera. Put it away and tell me what you actually need.

THREATEN_PLAYER.neutral: Step away from the outside gate. I'm calling this in from the secure gatehouse.
THREATEN_PLAYER.friendly: Stay outside and back away from the entrance. I don't want to call security, but I will.
THREATEN_PLAYER.irritated: You're still outside a locked perimeter. Touch that gate and I'm calling security.
THREATEN_PLAYER.hostile: The gate is locked and you're on camera. Try to force it and security is coming.
weapon: Stop. You're outside a locked gate and I'm inside the gatehouse. Keep the weapon down and move away from the entrance.
Back away from the outside gate and lower the gun. You're on camera, and that weapon cannot open the security door.

acknowledgement: I understand you're in a difficult spot.
I don't want this to cost you your job.
boundary: I still have a duty to protect this place.
That alone doesn't give me grounds to unlock the warehouse.
Give me something concrete and I'll listen.

friendly: I do understand. Give me something I can verify and I'll see what I can do.
You've been decent with me. Help me justify it and I'll try to help you.
SHOW_SYMPATHY.irritated: I understand your problem. That doesn't make it mine.
SHOW_SYMPATHY.hostile: Save the story. It isn't opening that door.

challenge: Something about that doesn't add up.
Hold on, [[address]]. Your account has changed.
That's not the reason you gave me before.
request: What are you really doing here?

challenge: Offering me something makes this look worse.
You don't buy your way through this door.
boundary: Keep your money and explain why you're really here.
Try to bribe me again and we're done.

BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.friendly: Maybe I've misunderstood, but your story isn't quite lining up.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.irritated: Now you're changing your story. What are you really doing here?
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.hostile: I knew it. You've been lying to me.

nextStep: Tell me what you actually need and we'll go from there.

boundary: I'm still not sure I believe you.
That story still doesn't add up.
nextStep: So tell me what really brought you here.
Tell me the truth about why you're here.

boundary: Keep it civil and we can continue.
nextStep: What is it you need from the warehouse?

friendly: I appreciate the honesty. Tell me what you actually need.
All right. Say it straight and I'll hear you out.
irritated: That helps, but it doesn't wipe out what happened. Tell me the truth.
You've got one chance. What are you really here for?
REPAIR_CONVERSATION.hostile: I hear the apology. Keep your distance and explain yourself carefully.

END_CONVERSATION.friendly: I can't help you, [[address]]. Please go home.
END_CONVERSATION.irritated: That's enough. We're done. Leave the property.
END_CONVERSATION.hostile: Conversation over. Get off the property before I call the police.
END_CONVERSATION.weapon: Keep the weapon lowered and step away from the door. I'm ending this conversation so nobody gets hurt.

pal.opening: Evening, pal. I can see you outside on the gate camera. I'm in the locked gatehouse and the warehouse is closed, so tell me what you need.

REFUSE_ENTRY: No, pal. That story doesn't open this door.
Come on, pal. You know that isn't enough.
ASK_FOR_REASON: All right, pal, give it to me straight. What do you need?
Make it quick, pal. Why are you here?
ASK_FOR_PROOF: Okay, pal. You got a badge, a work order, something with a name on it?
You say it's official. Fine. Show me something official.
ALLOW_ENTRY: All right, pal, it checks out. In, do the job, come right back.
Okay. You're good. Stay where I can see you.
SHOW_SYMPATHY: Yeah, I hear you, pal. Doesn't mean I can pop the door.
I get it. Bad night. Give me something real and maybe I can help.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS: Hold it, pal. That's not the story you gave me.
Come on. Now you're changing it. What's really going on?
REPAIR_CONVERSATION: All right, pal, apology heard. Now give it to me straight.
Fine. We keep talking. No more games.

sir.opening: Good evening, sir. You're outside at the south-gate intercom; I'm inside the locked gatehouse. We're closed for the night, so what brings you here?

REFUSE_ENTRY: I can't open the door on that alone, sir. You'll need to come back in the morning.
Sorry, sir. I don't have enough to let you in.
ASK_FOR_REASON: What brings you here this late, sir?
What do you need inside the warehouse?

request: All right. Have you got a work order or some ID I can look at?
If you're here on a job, I'll need a badge or a work order.

branches.template: I understand, sir. What I need now is the work order or your ID.
Coffee machines at this hour? All right, sir. Let me see the work order and your ID.

ALLOW_ENTRY: All right, that matches up. I'll let you through, but stay where I can see you.
Okay, you're cleared to go in. Stick to the job and check back with me on your way out.
SHOW_SYMPATHY: I understand, sir. I still need something I can check before I open the door.
I know this is inconvenient. Give me something I can put in the log and I'll hear you out.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS: Hold on, sir. That's not what you told me a moment ago. Which version is true?
Your story's changed. Tell me plainly what's going on.
REPAIR_CONVERSATION: All right, sir. I appreciate the apology. Tell me what actually happened.
Okay. We can keep talking, but I need the straight story from here.

mate.opening: Evening, mate. I've got you outside on the south-gate camera; I'm in the locked gatehouse. Warehouse is shut for the night, but tell me what I can do for you.
mate.nameAcknowledgement: [[playerName]], is it? Good to meet you.

REFUSE_ENTRY: I'd like to help you, mate, I really would, but I can't open the place on that alone.
I hear what you're saying, and I don't want to leave you stuck, but the door has to stay shut.
ASK_FOR_REASON: Go on then, mate, tell me the whole thing. What brings you out here at this hour?
Take your time and tell me what you need inside. Better I hear it properly than guess, isn't it?
ASK_FOR_PROOF: That might be fair enough, mate, but give me something I can point to—a badge, a ticket, a name, anything official.
Help me help you here. If you've a work order or a reference, show me and we'll see where we are.
ALLOW_ENTRY: There we are, mate, that all checks out. I'll let you through, but stay where I can see you and we'll have no trouble.
Right, that's what I needed. In you go, do what you came to do, and come back this way when you're finished.
SHOW_SYMPATHY: Ah, mate, that's a rough spot to be in. I can't promise the door, but give me something I can verify and I'll do what I can.
I do understand, honestly. I've had nights go sideways myself. Tell me what you've got and maybe we can sort something out.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS: Hold on now, mate. That's not quite what you told me before, and I need to know which version I'm meant to believe.
You've lost me there. The story changed halfway through, so talk me through what really happened.
REPAIR_CONVERSATION: Fair enough, mate, apology accepted. Let's keep it straight from here and tell me what you actually need.
All right, I appreciate you saying that. We can keep talking, but give me the honest version this time.

friend.opening: Evening, friend. I see you outside on camera. I am inside locked gatehouse. Warehouse closed tonight. What you need?

REFUSE_ENTRY: No, friend. Not enough. Door stays shut.
I cannot open for this. Come back tomorrow.
ASK_FOR_REASON: Tell me. Why are you here?
ASK_FOR_PROOF: You have papers? ID? Work order? Show me.
Official job needs official proof. What you have?
ALLOW_ENTRY: Good. Papers match. You go in; I watch.
All right, friend. You enter. Do job, then come out.
SHOW_SYMPATHY: I understand. Still no entry without proof.
Bad situation, friend. Rules do not change.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS: Story changed. Which one is true?
No. Before you say different. Tell truth now.
REPAIR_CONVERSATION: Good. We speak straight now. What you need?
Apology accepted, friend. No more games.
